pages.text: Dandoona goes to a picnic.
She brings an apple and a banana.
A cat and a dog come too.
A duck brings an egg.
Yum! What a happy picnic!
The cat has a hat.
A hen naps on a bed.
The pig has a big fig.
The dog sits by the pot.
A bug is in the cup! Fun!
A fish is in a dish.
The chick has a chip.
A moth sits on the bench.
The duck has red socks.
We run to the ship. Fun!
A frog is on a drum.
A crab has a flag.
The truck has blocks.
A plum is in my hand.
A gift! Clap, clap!
A snake has a cake.
Five kites fly up!
I ride my bike to the plane.
A rose is on my nose!
The dog has a bone. Magic!
The rain is on the train.
A snail is on the tree.
A goat and a sheep in a boat!
A bee sits on the toast.
The moon and a star. Good night!
I see the cat.
My dog is on the bed.
The bug is in the cup.
We can go on the bus.
A hen and a duck! Fun!
Look at the kite!
Here is a fish.
He was in the bath.
She has a cake.
They are bees! Buzz!
The cat is big.
The pigs are pink.
I have an egg.
I see an ant.
The kites are up! Hooray!
The rat has a hat.
The pig has a wig.
A bug is on the rug.
I run in the sun.
A hot bun in a pan! Yum!
